title: Northeast Winters and Large-Scale Climate Patterns
text: Although long-term climate trends are not as noticeable as day-to-day weather conditions, they affect long-term patterns of day-to-day weather significantly. Several climate patterns affect the weather in the United States, with the El Niño Southern Oscillation (ENSO) cycle being the most impactful and well-known.
